panels.label: 携带展示
panels.copy_purpose: 根据包型进行手持、肩背或斜挎展示
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show one adult model carrying the exact bag naturally using the most structurally appropriate visible handle or strap.
panels.backdrop_en: Refined neutral urban interior with minimal decor.
panels.composition_en: Show the entire bag, its natural scale, handle or strap connection, and body contact; keep the left side calm.
panels.lighting_en: Soft directional daylight revealing material and hardware.

panels.label: 结构展示
panels.copy_purpose: 包体轮廓、侧面厚度、开合与承托结构
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create a clean three-quarter product view documenting the exact bag silhouette, base, gusset, opening, handles, and straps.
panels.composition_en: Keep the complete bag upright and undistorted in the upper-middle; reserve the lower area.
panels.lighting_en: Large softbox light with controlled edge definition.

panels.label: 工艺展示
panels.copy_purpose: 完整包体中突出材质纹理、缝线、五金、拉链和品牌元素
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact complete bag in a detail-led commercial photograph, using angle and light to reveal material texture, stitching, hardware, closure, and visible brand elements without cropping the bag.
panels.backdrop_en: Minimal tonal studio background matching the product palette.
panels.composition_en: Keep the entire bag and all handles or straps inside frame; make defining details readable on the left and keep the upper-right quiet.
panels.lighting_en: Raking daylight with realistic texture and metal reflections.

panels.label: 生活方式
panels.copy_purpose: 符合商品用途的通勤或日常场景
panels.scene_prompt_en: Place the exact bag in a believable premium daily-use scene without adding products or hiding its structure.
panels.backdrop_en: Quiet modern cafe or office transition space with sparse props.
panels.composition_en: Keep the full bag in the lower-right and reserve the upper-left.
panels.lighting_en: Warm natural afternoon light, commercially polished.

panels.label: 品牌主视觉
panels.copy_purpose: 完整商品广告主视觉，突出轮廓和品牌识别
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create a premium isolated hero advertisement of the exact complete bag at a natural three-quarter angle.
panels.backdrop_en: Sculptural warm-neutral studio with subtle tonal planes.
panels.composition_en: Center the complete product slightly left and preserve a quiet lower-right area.
panels.lighting_en: Controlled campaign lighting with clean silhouette separation.
